map.根据冷敷部位和目的计算安全冷敷时长，提供计时提醒，防止冻伤。每次冷敷后需间隔休息: Computes safe cold-pack duration by site and purpose, with a timer reminder to prevent frostbite. Rest between sessions.
map.安全冷敷时长 = 部位基准时长 × 敏感度系数；一般部位 20 分钟、敏感或儿童: Safe duration = site base x sensitivity factor; general site 20 min, sensitive/child site 10-15 min; rest 30-60 min between sessions, <=4-6 times/24 h, check skin color and sensation every 5 min.
map.冰袋外包裹毛巾，避免直接接触皮肤；冷敷时观察皮肤颜色变化（苍白、发紫应立即停止）: Wrap the pack in a towel, avoid direct skin contact; watch color change (pallor/cyanosis means stop at once).
map.警告：糖尿病、末梢循环障碍、感觉障碍患者冷敷时间应减半，并增加观察频率。如出现皮: Warning: halve duration for diabetes, poor circulation or sensory loss, and check more often. Stop immediately on pallor, numbness or tingling.
map.运动扭伤急性期（24–48h）每 15–20 分钟冷敷、间隔≥1 小时，避免冻伤: Acute sports sprain (24-48 h): cold 15-20 min each, >=1 h apart, avoid frostbite.
map.术后切口肿胀冷敷，设定单次≤20 分钟并垫纱布隔离皮肤。: Post-op incision swelling: single session <=20 min with gauze barrier.
map.小儿或糖尿病患者感觉迟钝，缩短单次时长并加强巡视。: Children or diabetics have dulled sensation; shorten sessions and monitor closely.
map.输入部位=踝、皮肤正常，工具给出 15 分钟冷敷加 60 分钟间隔、每日 3–4: Input site=ankle, normal skin; tool gives 15 min cold + 60 min interval, 3-4/day, matching physiotherapy orders.
map.本工具能替代医嘱吗？: Can this tool replace the doctor's order?
map.不能，仅作计时提醒，具体频次与时长以医师处方为准。: No; it only times. Frequency and duration follow the prescription.
map.皮肤发白或麻木怎么办？: What if skin turns white or numb?
map.立即停用并复温，警惕冻伤，必要时就诊。: Stop and rewarm at once; watch for frostbite, seek care if needed.
map.急性期后改热敷促进吸收，长期冷敷反不利循环，按病程切换。: After the acute phase switch to heat to aid absorption; prolonged cold hurts circulation. Switch per course.
map.按部位与皮肤耐受设定冷敷时长与间隔，预防冻伤并规范急性期消肿。: Sets cold duration and interval by site and tolerance to prevent frostbite and standardize acute-phase swelling care.
